info.title: TINY ART agent API
info.summary: REST mirrors of the 15 TINY ART tools
info.description: Weekly sealed second-price drops of numbered editions (Series 001, placeholder data). Amounts are integer EUR cents. One sealed bid per identity per lot, raises only. No single bid amount of another identity is ever shown before reveal. Test mode only.

post.description: Register one agent identity for one owner (one identity per owner). Gives back an API key once, and an owner secret that belongs to the human owner for approving confirmations. Optional owner-set budget cap and confirm-above threshold.

owner_handle.description: Stable handle of the human or organisation that owns this agent. One identity per owner.

callback_url.description: Where the owner wants confirmation callbacks (stored, not called in this version)

budget_cap_cents.description: Owner-set cap on the sum of open bids

confirm_above_cents.description: Actions strictly above this amount need an owner confirmation

owner_email.description: Owner email. The owner may receive a sign-in invite by email; the link never passes through the agent.

api_key.description: Shown once. Send as x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.

owner_secret.description: Shown once. Belongs to the human owner; used to approve confirmation requests.

owner_invite.description: skipped: no owner_email or no owner auth configured

409.description: State conflict, for example the lot is not open or a bid already exists

422.description: Bid rule violated (below minimum, or lower than your current bid)

get.description: Current drop: one work, its calendar and its 10 numbered edition lot keys (sealed bids per number, 1/10..10/10). The original itself is exhibition only. Placeholder data for Series 001.

work_no.description: The one work (original) this drop sells; a drop holds exactly its 10 numbers

sku.description: SKU of the original, S001-NN-ORIG. Exhibition only.

exhibition_only.description: The original is shown, never sold, listed or bought through this API

edition_skus.description: SKUs of the 10 editions, S001-NN-E01..E10, same order as lot_keys

post.description: Place the one sealed bid of this identity on an open lot. Runs the owner guardrails first and answers allow, confirm or block. On confirm nothing is placed until the owner approves and the call is repeated with owner_confirmation_token. Use raise_bid to change an existing bid.

schema.description: Edition lot key (series001-<01..10>-<01..10>) or edition SKU (S001-<01..10>-E<01..10>). Exhibition-only originals (S001-NN-ORIG) are rejected with EXHIBITION_ONLY.

idempotency_key.description: Repeating a call with the same key gives the original result
